title: Softer PPI Eases 50bp Fed Hike Bets; Market Prices ~88% Odds of 25bp in December
detail: A softer-than-expected US PPI pulled front-end Treasury yields lower and steepened the curve, after Waller's 50bp-hike signal and the hot October CPI earlier in the week. Pricing before the release implied roughly 88% odds of a 25bp December hike versus 12% for 50bp. Bank of America expects 25bp hikes in December, January and March. Retail sales and FOMC minutes are the next key releases.

media.caption: Treasury wrap: T-note futures settle higher after PPI
